title.suggested: Allen backed a wrestler against Greek George

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Greek George beat Antonio Pierre, backed by Tom Allen, in two straight falls in a private catch-as-catch-can wrestling match for $200 a side.

facts.fact: Allen backed the wrestler Antonio Pierre, who lost two straight falls to Greek George in a private catch-as-catch-can match for $200 a side

notes: Current summary says Allen supported Greek George; the article says George was backed by John Delargy and Pierre by Allen. 'Backed' means he put up the stakes, not that he seconded him, so the title 'took the corner' is misleading. Place not named; St. Louis assumed from the paper.
